title: Cap Base for the Rent Increase Limit on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Clause.** The cap base is the rent the limit percentage of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is applied to:

1. where the agreement's latest rent charge on the ledger is below its contracted monthly rent, the cap base is that latest rent charge, as billed;
2. where the agreement's last rent change was a retention concession and no lower rent is billed, the cap base is the rent the conceded increase had noticed;
3. otherwise the cap base is the contracted monthly rent.

The last rent change is the change whose effective date is the agreement's last rent change date; it was a retention concession when the rent change history shows a retention concession effective on that date, and the rent the conceded increase had noticed is the new rent of the existing-customer increase effective on that same date.

## Decision table

| Latest rent charge below contracted rent | Last rent change a retention concession | Cap base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the latest rent charge |
| no | yes | the rent the conceded increase had noticed |
| no | no | the contracted monthly rent |

## Hypothetical cases

- Contracted rent $140.00, latest charge $126.00 under a military discount: cap base $126.00.
- Rent raised by a noticed increase to $160.00, conceded to $152.00, both effective 10 May; latest charge $152.00: cap base $160.00.
- Contracted rent $152.00, latest charge $152.00, last change an existing-customer increase: cap base $152.00.
